headlines.name: Math115.RationalClockProposal.cappedIndex_none
headlines.statement:
∀ (V : ℕ),
  0 < V →
    ∀ (N : ℕ),
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
              (Math115.RationalClockProposal.cappedIndex V N)).mass
          none =
        (1 - Math115.RationalClockProposal.acceptance V) ^ N

headlines.name: Math115.RationalClockProposal.physicalProposal_variation
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hp :
    2 ≤
      Fintype.card
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
  (x : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
      (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
        (Math115.RationalClockProposal.physicalProposal r c U L x N))
      (Math115.RationalClockProposal.idealPhysicalProposalLaw r c U L hp x) ≤
    (1 / 2) ^ N

headlines.name: Math115.RationalClockProposal.idealPhysicalProposalLaw_mass
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀
      (hp :
        2 ≤
          Fintype.card
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)))
      (x : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (y : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
      (Math115.RationalClockProposal.idealPhysicalProposalLaw r c U L hp x).mass (some y) =
        if
            OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.physicalAdjacent r c U L
              (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L) ⋯ (↑x) y then
          1 / ↑(Math115.RationalClockProposal.denominator r c U)
        else 0

headlines.name: Math115.RationalClockProposal.rational_clock_cast
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U : ℕ),
  ↑(1 / ↑(Math115.RationalClockProposal.denominator r c U)) =
    1 / (2 * ↑(Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.defectAllowance r c U))
